name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role, based out of your Denver hub. Before my SaaS career I spent more than 15 years as a cook across different kinds of restaurants, so I know the service industry from the inside: the staffing pressure, the pace, and how little patience operators have for software that doesn't earn its place in the shift.

Since then my work has been owning customer relationships on SaaS platforms. At Birdeye I retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners by watching utilization in Salesforce, stepping in on accounts that showed risk, and bringing structured feedback to Product and Engineering. At Wix I managed a high-value portfolio and onboarded 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets, and at Accelo I advised executives on how to run their operations through the platform.

My accounts have been mid-market rather than Fortune 500, and the core skill carries over: learning how each stakeholder needs to be communicated with, from the operator on the floor to the executive sponsor. I'm local to Denver, open to travel, and would welcome a conversation.
